evidence_notes: Patient is 35, female, diagnosed with Crohn's at 28. Also has endometriosis and chronic migraines. Initially treated with prednisone and mesalamine. Then Remicade for 4 years, which stopped working. Currently on Stelara, reporting ~60% improvement. Endometriosis pain is severe and impacts treatment choices due to need for surgery and immunosuppression. Also dealing with opioid side effects impacting Crohn's. Considering combination therapy (Stelara + methotrexate). Left investment banking for a more flexible role due to health. Facing challenges with dating and family expectations regarding children due to chronic illness. Insurance battles are constant. Considering clinical trials.
